tools.name: get_market_sentiment
tools.description: Current crypto market sentiment snapshot with BTC price, 24-hour change, fear/greed, confidence and source-attributed reasoning. Cached; no input required.

tools.name: check_token_security
tools.description: Rug-pull and token security lookup for one exact contract, including available liquidity, authority, holder concentration, honeypot and tax flags. Use before buying a new or low-cap token.

tools.name: get_alpha
tools.description: Acai's bounded alpha signal feed with tiered signals and evidence. Use to review early altcoin and memecoin opportunities. Research, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_prediction_markets
tools.description: Crypto-relevant prediction-market events and odds with recent market context. Use to gauge crowd expectations for crypto and macro events.

tools.name: get_perps
tools.description: Perpetual futures market context from Hyperliquid, including funding and open interest where available. Use to assess positioning and liquidation risk.

tools.name: get_alpha_launch
tools.description: Read the member's fresh, verified Alpha Launch feed. Preserve nextCursor and minScore when polling.

tools.name: get_alpha_surge
tools.description: Read the member-safe Alpha Surge evidence feed; private wallet, contributor and diagnostic fields are removed.

tools.name: get_daily_picks
tools.description: Read today's persisted Acai Daily picks with public evidence and source timestamps.

tools.name: get_forensics
tools.description: Run or resume exact-contract Forensics. Use a supported chain and contract address, not a ticker; repeat the same inputs if the response says research is still running.

tools.name: start_asset_research
tools.description: Create an owner-scoped, resumable exact-contract job. Each source consumes its usual member quota; optionally include Forensics/security. Supply a stable requestKey, then poll or resume by taskId.

tools.name: get_asset_research_job
tools.description: Read the status and saved evidence for one of your durable research jobs.

tools.name: resume_asset_research_job
tools.description: Resume a partial or interrupted research job using its original exact-contract inputs; completed jobs are not rerun.

tools.name: create_asset_monitor
tools.description: Create a persistent owner-scoped exact-contract monitor. Each due check consumes the selected sources' usual member quotas; the agent controls polling and can stop it. Use a stable requestKey.

tools.name: list_asset_monitors
tools.description: List only your persistent exact-contract monitors and their saved check state.

tools.name: check_asset_monitor
tools.description: Check an owned monitor when its poll is due, save the latest evidence, and return its next scheduled check. Repeated calls before due time do not trigger provider work.

tools.name: stop_asset_monitor
tools.description: Stop one of your persistent monitors. This does not affect research history or other members' monitors.

tools.name: research_asset
tools.description: Combine exact-contract evidence from Launch, Surge and Daily; optionally include Forensics or token security. Each included member route consumes its usual quota. Repeat the same inputs to resume a 503 Forensics run.

tools.name: monitor_asset
tools.description: Perform a bounded fresh check of one exact contract using the same inputs on each poll. This is read-only; the agent controls polling frequency and may stop at any time.
